r_theta: FROZEN -- no retraining, and no h_phi exists in this lane

P.name: potency
P.note: log-odds, never P(active): the pool sits at median P(active)=0.004 where probability is saturated

D.name: developability
D.form: clipped soft-min over a QED floor and a cLogP box
D.escape_hatch_closed: if O-D fails the saturation gate, this lane may NOT substitute an unclipped soft-min or QED alone; that is a main-lane decision

S.name: source_similarity
S.centre_recipe: held-in median over the census candidate set
S.scale_recipe: held-in IQR over the census candidate set
S.note: the recipe is predeclared; the numbers are written into diagnostics/pareto_tradeoff_census.json at Phase 0, before any gate statistic is evaluated

adoption_rule: FIRST pair clearing all five gates. Positional, not best-of. Not reordered after results.

scalarization.why_not_weighted_sum_alone: a weighted sum can only select points on the convex hull of the front, so it systematically misses nonconvex regions and reports a smaller achievable front than exists

verified_pref.why_a_random_stratum: a candidate universe defined entirely by the greedy score cannot show that a non-greedy action was worth taking

metrics.primary: normalized_hypervolume over committed endpoints only, exactly five per arm per source
metrics.hv_auc_rule: both are reported together; neither may be substituted for the other
metrics.no_pvalue_reason: policy improvement fixes the sign; only the magnitude is admissible

withdrawn_statistics.sacrifice_to_win: action chosen as argmax V_G, then scored by V_G
withdrawn_statistics.verified_vs_greedy_sign_test: policy improvement makes the null of 0.5 false
withdrawn_statistics.best_candidate_reaches_pooled_p99: with a ~600-wide fiber this fires with probability 0.997 whatever the truth is

efficiency_metrics.evidence: the authorized 12-source smoke had emitted 6 arm checkpoints and ZERO DONE lines; DONE is the only place an HV value is printed
efficiency_metrics.reference_corner: held-in p5 from the frozen scales; never read off results
efficiency_metrics.utopia: held-in p99 from the frozen scales
efficiency_metrics.b90_never_reached: reported as None, never as the maximum budget

external_axis.forbidden: external methods are NEVER plotted on the trajectory axis; HN-GFN, GraphGA and REINVENT do not share a trajectory object

efficiency_metrics.honest_framing: higher final HV for an external method alongside better HV-AUC or far fewer oracle evaluations for COMPOSE is a GOOD result and is reported as such; if COMPOSE is worse on both, that is reported too; nothing is tuned to win final HV

two_references.r_nadir: held-in p5; the corner used to COMPUTE hypervolume; clean
two_references.HV_star: the TARGET whose 90% level defines budget-to-90%: pooled nondominated union of ALL predeclared methods at the common maximum evaluation budget
two_references.why_named_apart: conflating them is how a favourable ceiling survives review

efficiency_metrics.method_symmetric: a strong method that expands the pooled frontier raises the bar for everyone including itself

censoring.rule: report B_90 > B_max or mark CENSORED
censoring.why: substituting the maximum makes a method that never got there look like one that got there at the last moment -- a failure rendered as a success
censoring.aggregation: median over uncensored sources only, reported beside the censoring rate; a median pooling censored sources at B_max is the same substitution one level up

N_90.HV_star_internal: pooled terminal union of the PREDECLARED INTERNAL ARMS at the fixed maximum number of trajectories
N_90.axis: completed controlled trajectories; COMPOSE arms only

method_universe.external: internal universe plus every qualified external method; none qualified yet, so today it equals the internal universe and B_90 is internal-only
method_universe.guard: check_method_universe() raises MethodUniverseError on any drift
method_universe.why: a union that silently gains or loses a method changes every B_90 in the table while nothing in the table appears to change

hv_range.why: z* is the held-in p99, not a maximum; controlled trajectories pass it (census G4 potency reach 0.700; first completed smoke source HV 1.0074). The box is a normalizer, never a cap -- clipping would suppress real achievement and hide ceiling effects.
hv_range.corrected: an earlier line claimed HV in [0,1]; that was FALSE. The metric is unchanged, only the description.
hv_range.ratios_unaffected: HV_star carries the identical normalizer, so B_90 and N_90 are invariant to the box constant
